lines.zh: 我绕着竹叶走，不碰落一片。
lines.en: I circle the bamboo leaves without touching one.

lines.zh: 翅上的月牙在树影里一闪。
lines.en: The crescent on my wings flashes between tree shadows.

lines.zh: 我贴着白桦皮滑行，像片落叶。
lines.en: I glide along birch bark, a leaf that climbs.

lines.zh: 黑森林太暗，我靠翅粉照路。
lines.en: The dark forest is dark; my wing dust lights the way.

lines.zh: 我飞成一道弯月，从不走直线。
lines.en: I fly in a crescent arc and never go straight.
Bamboo winds are strong; I borrow them to save strength.

lines.zh: 三只一伙太挤，我一向独飞。
lines.en: Three would crowd the sky; I always fly alone.

lines.zh: 竹影里多一小块，那是我。
lines.en: A small dark fleck in the bamboo shade is me.

lines.zh: 夜里我往月光最亮处飞。
lines.en: At night I fly toward the brightest patch of moonlight.

lines.zh: 白桦叶背是我的歇脚处。
lines.en: The underside of a birch leaf is where I rest.

lines.zh: 我顺着光斑走，像被线牵着。
lines.en: I follow the light spots as if on a thread.

lines.zh: 翅膜薄，风一大我就贴地。
lines.en: My wing membrane is thin; strong wind sends me low.
I skirt the cobwebs; they are sticky on wings.

lines.zh: 黑森林的菌伞下能躲雨。
lines.en: The mushroom caps of the dark forest shelter me from rain.
I fly along the moonlight on the creek

lines.zh: 翅上的粉落了一点在水面。
lines.en: A little wing dust falls onto the water

lines.zh: 我停在竹节上，翅合如叶。
lines.en: I rest on a bamboo node, wings folded like a leaf.

lines.zh: 翅粉一抖，落下一点月白。
lines.en: A flick of dust drops one fleck of moon white.
I am waiting for the moon to reach the treetops.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的粉会粘你。
lines.en: Not so close; my dust will cling to you.
One sip of nectar is all I take in a day.
I am counting the sounds the bamboo leaves make.

lines.zh: 翅上有块暗斑，像小月食。
lines.en: A dark blotch on my wing looks like a small eclipse.
I barely breathe, saving what little strength I have.
If no one comes, I simply keep hanging here.
Moonlight settles on my back, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我听见你在数我的翅膀。
lines.en: I hear you counting the spots on my wings.
The wind has turned; I move to another branch.
You are standing in my moonlight.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，翅膜一碰就破。
lines.en: Don't grab; my wing tears at a touch.
I look at you because you keep moving.

lines.zh: 你的火把太亮，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Your torch is too bright; I cannot keep my eyes open.

lines.zh: 我认得你帽檐上的月牙。
lines.en: I know the crescent on the brim of your hat.
You carry no scent of pollen at all.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，只为看你的耳后。
lines.en: Half a loop, just to see behind your ear.

lines.zh: 我把翅影投在你的帽檐上。
lines.en: My wing shadow falls across your hat brim.
Don't blink; if you blink, I'm gone.
Your shadow is prettier than this moonlight.
It hurts; a corner of my wing is gone.

lines.zh: 你打下的粉，能照亮一寸地。
lines.en: The dust you knocked off could light a foot of ground.
I can't fly high now; stop chasing.
That blow dropped me into the grass.
The membrane tore; wind will pour in now.
The pain has taken my voice away.
You have a piece of my wing in your palm.
One more hit and I can only crawl.
Moon dust is leaking from my wound.
I will carry this notch in my wing away.

lines.zh: 花蜜我闻得出，你手里没有。
lines.en: I can smell nectar, and your hands hold none.
Breadcrumbs? I only drink dew.
You hold out a flower; I refuse to land.

lines.zh: 糖太甜，会粘住我的口器。
lines.en: Sugar is too sweet; it clogs my mouthparts.
I only trust flowers that open at night.
You shook that flower; the nectar spilled.
The smell of a golden apple overwhelms me.
Stop waving; light spots serve me better than food.
Landing on your shoulder is only on my way.
Move your hand; you're flattening my shadow.
A bump costs nothing; I am nearly weightless.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞散了我的粉。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked the dust off my wings.
I slide off the plate of your armor.
Don't swat; one hit cracks a wing.
I back off three steps and hover in the air.

lines.zh: 你走路不看脚下，也不看头顶。
lines.en: You watch neither your feet nor the air above.
Hitting that bamboo pole was the wind's fault.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味熏到我了。
lines.en: The iron smell on you is choking me.
Step aside; I need this gap to pass.
You nearly pressed me flat into the grass.

lines.zh: 我翅上的月纹是求偶用的。
lines.en: The moon marks on my wings are for courting.
When we pair, we fly in slow circles.
I am the only one of my kind in this forest.

lines.zh: 月圆那晚才看得见同伴。
lines.en: Companions only appear on the night of a full moon.

lines.zh: 我们不筑巢，只留一枚卵。
lines.en: We build no nest, only leave a single egg.

lines.zh: 追我的那只翅上少一角。
lines.en: The one courting me is missing a wingtip.

lines.zh: 我被拒过，翅粉白掉一半。
lines.en: I was refused once, and half my dust went pale.
Stop watching; this part is private.
We only recognize each other under moonlight.
Finding a mate means crossing the whole bamboo grove.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，翅膀拿不住。
lines.en: I pick up nothing; my wings cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 那块月尘是我掉的，别捡。
lines.en: That moon dust is mine, dropped; leave it.

lines.zh: 我搬得动的最多一粒花粉。
lines.en: The heaviest thing I can carry is a pollen grain.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，我看看。
lines.en: Set it on the ground and let me look.
Don't shove flowers under my wings.
My feet are too fine to grip a thread.
That is not food; it's a piece of gravel.

lines.zh: 我只把花粉从这花搬到那花。
lines.en: I only carry pollen from this flower to that one.
Why pick it up? You can't eat it.
The one in your hand weighs more than I do.
You crushed my moon dust underfoot.

lines.zh: 我盯上的不是猎物，是光。
lines.en: What I fix on is not prey; it is light.
That swing of your hand startled me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，不是要攻击。
lines.en: I circle you, and it is not an attack.
Leave that night flower; it is mine.

lines.zh: 你踏进竹林，我就看见了。
lines.en: The moment you entered the bamboo, I saw you.

lines.zh: 我记住了你火把的颜色。
lines.en: I have memorized the color of your torch.

lines.zh: 我翅粉沾到你，就认得你。
lines.en: My dust touched you, so I know you now.
You stepped on the leaf I rest on.

lines.zh: 我要靠近，是好奇不是敌意。
lines.en: Coming closer is curiosity, not hostility.
This patch of moonlight is under my care.
When you move, my moon marks brighten.
I keep my eyes on the fire in your hand.
One more step and I rise out of reach.
I am measuring the edges of your shadow.
Don't raise your hand; it looks like a swatter.
I move to your unlit side to watch you.
Your breathing is heavier than the wind.
My wingtip is aimed at your eyes.
The moonlight shifts an inch; I shift an inch.
That flower behind you is moving.
I drop lower so I can see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你鞋上的泥是黑森林的。
lines.en: The mud on your boots is from the dark forest.
Hold still; I am learning your scent.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，只能撞你一下。
lines.en: I have no teeth; a bump is all I can do.
Dust in your eyes will have you rubbing a while.
I bump you because I want you to back off.
This blow lands as light as a falling leaf.

lines.zh: 我的武器是让人看不清。
lines.en: My weapon is making you unable to see.

lines.zh: 别逼我，翅粉有毒是假话。
lines.en: Don't push me; the poison dust rumor is false.

lines.zh: 我咬不动你，也咬不穿布。
lines.en: I can't bite you, nor bite through cloth.
A layer of silver dust has settled on you.
All I do is flutter at your face.
After this one hit, I am leaving.

lines.zh: 我从竹林的月色里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the moonlight in the bamboo grove.

lines.zh: 白桦林落一片叶，我就到了。
lines.en: A birch leaf falls, and there I am.
The shadows of the dark forest gather into me.

lines.zh: 这片林子一次只生我一只。
lines.en: This forest births only one of me at a time.
I am rare; you are lucky to see me.
Moon dust condenses on my wings.

lines.zh: 你来时，我刚从茧里出来。
lines.en: I had just left the cocoon when you came.
Only tonight's warm wind let me hatch.

lines.zh: 我落在你火把的余光里。
lines.en: I land in the glow your torch leaves behind.
Don't startle; I am only a butterfly.
One lick of fire and my wing edge curls.
I fell that far; my wings are flattened.
The water washed all my dust away.
The blast flung me three yards away.
That arrow went straight through my wing.
Magic makes the marks on my wings burn.
I am too hungry to lift my wings.
Lightning is far harsher than moonlight.
There is no moonlight in the void, only cold.
